statement: Releasing is deterministic and cheap: the exit is full corpus green on the exact SHA plus the tag workflow's artifact build and smoke plus an honest changelog; one preflight script replaces the digest-bound row Quests and local receipts; formation health is a machine-readable verdict with a standing trend and a local seed-starvation gate rather than a release gate.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
